description: Read the same per-client advance balances shown in ExpenseBot's Client advances section. Use for questions like 'how much of Acme's advance remains?', 'which client floats are still open?', or 'do I owe a client a refund?'. A negative ledger balance means money remains to refund; a positive balance means the client owes the user. Returns the existing app handoff for Refund leftover or Bill Client. Read-only: never records a refund, creates an invoice, or recomputes the ledger in model prose.

clientEmail.description: Client account email. Accountants may use this only for an accepted ExpenseBot client.

clientName.description: Optional client name or canonical Client tag. Omit to list every open balance backed by a recorded client advance.

name: get_client_advance_balances
